name: parsecontext-chunk1221
note: Lexer and include-aware lump parse from parsecontext.cpp (1-340).
auditSeams: strtoll and strtod are the host libc conversions, and the int cast keeps the low 32 bits. isspace, isdigit, isalpha, and isalnum are C-locale ASCII. strnicmp is strncasecmp. A single < or > consumes the next character and returns 0. << or >> without = returns 0 and ungets the following character. A 79-character identifier whose last stored character is _ is ungot. #include and #define match 7 and 6 characters with no token boundary. SourceFile for an include is the token union, so the next token that writes the union replaces that name. A bad include returns without restoring SourceLine or SourceFile.
auditRationale: UNCredited parsecontext.cpp 1-340 (+340). The file ends at 340. A full tally line scan shows no overlap.
auditUncreditedRangeCheck: uncredited_range_check.py --file src/gamedata/xlat/parsecontext.cpp --start 1 --end 340 and a full tally line scan → no overlap.
auditManagedLocJustification: GetToken calls strtoll and strtod, which are not source lines in this file. The managed port contains those conversions, the C-locale character classes, and the 80-byte FParseToken union. SourceFile is a pointer into that union when an include name is the current token, so the slice keeps the alias instead of copying the lump name. That is why the managed file is over 150% of the 340-line source.
